result.detail: Three things you should know. (1) The interface spec, section 8, and the microarchitecture plan both call for a formal proof, with SymbiYosys job files at ADDR_WIDTH 4 and 8. This task only asks for rtl_source and testbench, so I left out the formal_spec and its properties; a follow-up formal task needs to supply them. (2) Unlike the microarchitecture section 4, which says the held address and data need no reset, I reset them anyway. Behaviour is the same either way. (3) The testbench uses `task` with `#`/`@` timing, so under Verilator it needs `--timing`/`--binary`.
